description: Buddy Phase 13 — Signal Intelligence & Adaptive Calibration. Based on 2025-2026 web research: Platt scaling for confidence calibration, regime-conditioned dynamic SL/TP, multi-horizon signal fusion across timeframes, trade outcome prediction from post-entry features, concept drift detection via rolling z-scores, and portfolio-level Kelly criterion with VaR constraints. DIRECTIVE: NEVER STOP. DONT ASK. ONLY ASK WHEN DESTRUCTIVE.

userStories.title: Adaptive confidence calibration via Platt scaling
userStories.description: Raw model confidence scores are poorly calibrated — a 0.70 prediction doesn't mean 70% actual win rate. Apply Platt scaling (logistic regression on model outputs vs actual outcomes) to transform raw scores into calibrated probabilities. Recalibrate periodically as market conditions shift.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/scanner/automation/confidence_calibrator.py with ConfidenceCalibrator class
fit(raw_scores, actual_outcomes) trains sigmoid calibration using sklearn LogisticRegression
calibrate(raw_score) returns calibrated probability (0.0-1.0)
Auto-loads historical trades from trade_journal_rl.json for fitting
Persists calibration parameters to trained_data/confidence_calibration.json
Integrated into engine.py: calibrate confidence before gate checks
Config flag: enable_confidence_calibration: bool = False in ScannerConfig
Minimum 30 trades required before calibration activates (falls back to raw otherwise)
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: ConfidenceCalibrator created with full Platt scaling pipeline: sklearn LogisticRegression (primary) + manual binning fallback. fit_from_journal() loads trade_journal_rl.json, extracts (confidence, outcome) pairs, fits sigmoid. calibrate() applies sigmoid transform. Auto-refit every 20 new trades. Manual fallback uses binned logit regression. Wired into engine.py after microstructure lift, before Kelly sizing. Config flags added, smart profile enabled.

userStories.title: Regime-conditioned dynamic SL/TP optimization
userStories.description: Static ATR multipliers leave money on table in trends and get stopped out too early in volatile regimes. Implement 4 dynamic adaptation rules: (1) trend-widen — widen TP in strong trends, (2) early-tighten — tighten SL if trade moves against within first N bars, (3) vol-relax — widen SL in high-vol to avoid noise stops, (4) trailing — adaptive trailing SL based on regime. Each rule is regime-conditioned and adjusts the base ATR multipliers.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/scanner/automation/dynamic_sl_tp.py with DynamicSLTPOptimizer class
optimize(base_sl_pips, base_tp_pips, regime, trend_strength, atr) returns optimized (sl, tp)
4 named rules: trend_widen, early_tighten, vol_relax, trailing_adaptive
Each rule has regime-specific multiplier tables (LOW/NORMAL/HIGH/EXTREME)
Integrated into engine.py: replace static ATR multipliers with dynamic optimizer output
Config flags: enable_dynamic_sl_tp: bool = False, sl_tp_aggressiveness: float = 1.0
Logs every adjustment with rule name, old/new values, and regime
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: DynamicSLTPOptimizer created with 4 rules: trend_widen (TP expansion in strong trends), early_tighten (SL contraction on low confidence), vol_relax (SL widening in high-vol regimes), trailing_adaptive (regime-specific trailing params). Each rule has regime-specific multiplier tables (LOW/NORMAL/HIGH/EXTREME). Aggressiveness parameter scales all rules. R:R 1.2:1 minimum enforced post-optimization. Wired into engine.py after ATR SL/TP computation. Config flags added, smart profile enabled.

userStories.title: Multi-horizon signal fusion with Bayesian model averaging
userStories.description: Currently signals come from a single timeframe. Fuse signals across 4 timeframes (1m, 5m, 1h, 4h) using Bayesian model averaging. Each timeframe gets a prior weight that updates based on recent accuracy. Agreement across timeframes produces an A/B/C grade that modifies trade confidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/scanner/automation/multi_horizon_fusion.py with MultiHorizonFusion class
add_signal(timeframe, direction, confidence, features) registers per-TF signals
fuse() returns FusionResult with fused_direction, fused_confidence, agreement_grade (A/B/C)
Grade A = all 4 agree, Grade B = 3/4 agree, Grade C = 2/4 or less
Bayesian weights: prior proportional to inverse error rate, updated every 50 trades
Confidence boost: Grade A +10%, Grade B +0%, Grade C -15%
Config flag: enable_multi_horizon_fusion: bool = False
Integrated into engine.py: fuse signals from available timeframes before agent evaluation
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: MultiHorizonFusion created with Bayesian model averaging across M1/M5/H1/H4 timeframes. add_signal() registers per-TF signals, fuse() computes weighted directional consensus with A/B/C agreement grading. Grade A (+10%), B (0%), C (-15%) confidence adjustments. Bayesian weights updated every 50 trades via exponential-decay inverse error rate. Primary M5 signal registered directly, H1/H4 derived from trend strength. Wired into engine.py before SL/TP optimization. Config flags added, smart profile enabled.

userStories.title: Trade outcome prediction from post-entry features
userStories.description: Once a trade is open, new information becomes available (MAE, MFE, momentum since entry, distance to SL/TP, time in trade). Train a GradientBoosting classifier on historical trade post-entry features to predict whether an open trade will win or lose. Use predictions to suggest early exits or position adjustments.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/scanner/automation/trade_outcome_predictor.py with TradeOutcomePredictor class
Features: dist_to_sl_pct, dist_to_tp_pct, mae_pips, mfe_pips, bars_in_trade, momentum_since_entry, current_vol_vs_entry_vol
fit(historical_trades) trains GradientBoostingClassifier from trade_journal_rl.json
predict(open_trade_features) returns (win_probability, suggested_action)
Actions: HOLD, TIGHTEN_SL, TAKE_PARTIAL, EXIT_EARLY
Minimum 50 historical trades required for training
Persists model params to trained_data/trade_outcome_model.json
Config flag: enable_trade_outcome_prediction: bool = False
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: TradeOutcomePredictor created with 7 post-entry features (dist_to_sl_pct, dist_to_tp_pct, mae_pips, mfe_pips, bars_in_trade, momentum_since_entry, current_vol_vs_entry_vol). GradientBoosting primary with logistic regression persistence layer. Manual fallback via gradient descent logistic regression. 4 action levels: HOLD (>0.55), TIGHTEN_SL (0.40-0.55), TAKE_PARTIAL (high MFE + declining), EXIT_EARLY (<0.30). Trained from trade_journal_rl.json with 50-trade minimum. Config flags added, smart profile enabled.

userStories.title: Anomaly detection and concept drift monitoring
userStories.description: Market regimes shift and model assumptions become stale (concept drift). Implement rolling z-score monitoring on prediction errors, agent disagreement, and microstructure anomalies. When drift is detected, trigger recalibration alerts and reduce confidence until models re-adapt.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/scanner/automation/concept_drift.py with ConceptDriftDetector class
update(prediction_error, agent_disagreement, micro_anomaly_score) tracks rolling stats
detect() returns DriftResult with drift_detected (bool), severity (LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH), affected_signals list
Rolling z-score window: 100 observations, drift threshold: z > 2.5
When drift detected: apply confidence_penalty (0.85 for LOW, 0.70 for MEDIUM, 0.50 for HIGH)
Persists drift history to trained_data/concept_drift_log.json
Config flag: enable_concept_drift_detection: bool = False
Integrated into engine.py scan loop: check drift before trade evaluation
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: ConceptDriftDetector created with rolling z-score on 3 streams: prediction_error, agent_disagreement, micro_anomaly. 100-observation rolling window, z>2.5 threshold. 3 severity levels: LOW (1 stream, 0.85x), MEDIUM (2 streams, 0.70x), HIGH (3 streams, 0.50x). Warmup phase of 20 observations before activation. Baselines auto-initialized from warmup data. Drift history persisted to concept_drift_log.json. Wired into engine.py after calibration, before Kelly sizing. Config flags added, smart profile enabled.

userStories.title: Portfolio-level Kelly criterion with VaR constraints
userStories.description: Current position sizing treats each trade independently. Implement portfolio-level Kelly criterion that considers all open positions, their correlations, and overall portfolio risk. Apply Half-Kelly for safety and enforce VaR constraints (max 15% portfolio risk at 95% confidence). Replaces per-trade sizing when portfolio context is available.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/scanner/automation/kelly_portfolio.py with KellyPortfolioOptimizer class
compute_kelly(win_rate, avg_win, avg_loss) returns full Kelly fraction
compute_half_kelly() returns conservative fraction for production use
portfolio_optimal_size(new_trade, open_positions, nav) returns risk-budgeted lot size
VaR constraint: total portfolio risk <= 15% of NAV at 95% confidence
Correlation-aware: reduces size when new trade correlates with existing positions
Persists portfolio risk snapshots to trained_data/kelly_portfolio.json
Config flag: enable_kelly_sizing: bool = False
Integrated into engine.py: Kelly sizing as final step before execution
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: KellyPortfolioOptimizer created with full pipeline: compute win_rate/avg_win/avg_loss from trade journal, full Kelly f*=(p*b-q)/b, Half-Kelly for production safety. portfolio_optimal_size() integrates VaR constraint (15% NAV max), correlation-aware reduction (static FX correlations, 0.3-1.0 multiplier), confidence scaling. Replaces simple risk_pct logic in engine.py when enabled. Config flags added, smart profile enabled.
